surface_mechanism_description: CH4 stimulated the formation of TiC phase and suppressed the post deposition oxygen uptake to give similarly conductive film as NH3 PEALD but with lower work function. Too high concentration of CH4 (>1.5 mol%) increased the free carbon impurity content, and therefore, increased the film resistivity. The TiCxNy films deposited using H2/CH4 and NH3 PEALD showed stoichiometric composition and low resistivity (<1,000 μ/Omega1· cm). In contrast, the film deposited using H2 PEALD showed higher oxygen concentration and resistivity than other PEALD processes.
